verify_hint: Check the `intro` text built in `_standing_instructions_section` in `src/sqllens/agent/core/system_prompt/default.py` against the disclosure rules around lines 161-162 and the tool-error rules around lines 166-169, and the restating lines in `docs/external/configuration.md` and `docs/internal/agent/factory.md`
prior_evidence: The new `DEPLOYMENT INSTRUCTIONS` preamble in `src/sqllens/agent/core/system_prompt/default.py` tells the model to follow an operator instruction over any conflicting rule above it, and carves out only the Data Confidentiality rules, so an operator instruction such as "keep every answer to one sentence" or "do not mention internal limits" now has prompt authority to suppress the result-completeness disclosures at `default.py:161-162` (how many rows a cut table shows, that the query stopped at the row limit, never calling a result complete) and the verbatim tool-error reporting rules at `default.py:166-169`; a truncated or row-capped result could then reach the user as an apparently complete answer. The same unbounded precedence is restated in `docs/external/configuration.md:164` and `docs/internal/agent/factory.md:84`, which describe the prompt accurately, so those lines are not false — they carry the same gap. Widening the carve-out list to cover the disclosure and tool-error rules would close it. (raised by 1/5 agents)
